operations.name: Obtain new client secret
operations.description: Obtain new client secret for Paylocity-issued client id. See Setup section for details.

code.description: A value sent with the 'ACTION NEEDED: Web Link API Credentials Expiring Soon.' email notification.

operations.name: Add new employee
operations.description: New Employee API sends new employee data directly to Web Pay. Companies who use the New Hire Template in Web Pay may require additional fields when hiring employees. New Employee API Requests will honor these required fields.

operations.name: Add new local tax
operations.description: Sends new employee local tax information directly to Web Pay.

filingStatus.description: Employee local tax filing status. Must match specific local tax setup. Max length: 50

residentPSD.description: Resident PSD (political subdivision code) applicable in PA. Must match Company setup. Max length: 9

workPSD.description: Work location PSD. Must match Company setup. Max length: 9

operations.name: Add new employee to web link
operations.description: Add new employee to Web Link will send partially completed or potentially erroneous new hire record to Web Link, where it can be corrected and competed by company administrator or authorized Paylocity Service Bureau employee.

additionalDirectDeposit.description: Add up to 19 direct deposit accounts in addition to the main direct deposit account. IMPORTANT: A direct deposit update will remove ALL existing main and additional direct deposit information in WebPay and replace with information provided on the request. GET API will not return direct deposit data.

benefitSetup.description: Add setup values used for employee benefits integration, insurance plan settings, and ACA reporting.

customBooleanFields.description: Up to 8 custom fields of boolean (checkbox) type value.

customDateFields.description: Up to 8 custom fields of the date type value.

customDropDownFields.description: Up to 8 custom fields of the dropdown type value.

customNumberFields.description: Up to 8 custom fields of numeric type value.

customTextFields.description: Up to 8 custom fields of text type value.

departmentPosition.description: Add home department cost center, position, supervisor, reviewer, employment type, EEO class, pay settings, and union information.

disabilityDescription.description: Indicates if employee has disability status.

employeeId.description: Leave blank to have Web Pay automatically assign the next available employee ID. Max length: 10

federalTax.description: Add federal tax amount type (taxCalculationCode), amount or percentage, filing status, and exemptions.

fitwExemptReason.description: Reason code for FITW exemption. Common values are *SE* (Statutory employee), *CR* (clergy/Religious). Max length: 30

futaExemptReason.description: Reason code for FUTA exemption. Common values are *501* (5019c)(3) Organization), *IC* (Independent Contractor). Max length: 30

gender.description: Employee gender. Common values *M* (Male), *F* (Female). Max length: 1

homeAddress.description: Add employee's home address, personal phone numbers, and personal email.

isEmployee943.description: Indicates if employee in agriculture or farming.

isSmoker.description: Indicates if employee is a smoker.

localTax.description: Add local tax code, filing status, and exemptions including PA-PSD taxes.

mainDirectDeposit.description: Add the main direct deposit account. After deposits are made to any additional direct deposit accounts, the remaining net check is deposited in the main direct deposit account. IMPORTANT: A direct deposit update will remove ALL existing main and additional direct deposit information in WebPay and replace with what is provided on the request. GET API will not return direct deposit data.

maritalStatus.description: Employee marital status. Common values *D (Divorced), M (Married), S (Single), W (Widowed)*. Max length: 10

medExemptReason.description: Reason code for Medicare exemption. Common values are *501* (5019c)(3) Organization), *IC* (Independent Contractor). Max length: 30

nonPrimaryStateTax.description: Add non-primary state tax code, amount type (taxCalculationCode), amount or percentage, filing status, exemptions, supplemental check (specialCheckCalc), and reciprocity code information.

preferredName.description: Employee preferred display name. Max length: 20

primaryPayRate.description: Add hourly or salary pay rate, effective date, and pay frequency.

primaryStateTax.description: Add primary state tax code, amount type (taxCalculationCode), amount or percentage, filing status, exemptions, and supplemental check (specialCheckCalc) information. Only one primary state is allowed.

priorLastName.description: Prior last name if applicable.Max length: 40

sitwExemptReason.description: Reason code for SITW exemption. Common values are *SE* (Statutory employee), *CR* (clergy/Religious). Max length: 30

ssExemptReason.description: Reason code for Social Security exemption. Common values are *SE* (Statutory employee), *CR* (clergy/Religious). Max length: 30

ssn.description: Employee social security number. Leave it blank if valid social security number not available. Max length: 11

status.description: Add employee status, change reason, effective date, and adjusted seniority date. Note that companies that are still in Implementation cannot hire future employees.

suffix.description: Employee name suffix. Common values are *Jr, Sr, II*.Max length: 30

suiExemptReason.description: Reason code for SUI exemption. Common values are *SE* (Statutory employee), *CR* (clergy/Religious). Max length: 30

suiState.description: Employee SUI (State Unemployment Insurance) state. Max length: 2

taxDistributionCode1099R.description: Employee 1099R distribution code. Common values are *7* (Normal Distribution), *F* (Charitable Gift Annuity). Max length: 1

taxForm.description: Employee tax form for reporting income. Valid values are *W2, 1099M, 1099R*. Default is W2. Max length: 15

veteranDescription.description: Indicates if employee is a veteran.

webTime.description: Add Web Time badge number and charge rate and synchronize Web Pay and Web Time employee data.

workAddress.description: Add employee's work address, phone numbers, and email. Work Location drop down field is not included.

operations.name: Add update additional rates
operations.description: Sends new or updated employee additional rates information directly to Web Pay.

changeReason.description: Not required. If populated, must match one of the system coded values available in the Additional Rates Change Reason drop down.

costCenter1.description: Not required. Valid values must match one of the system coded cost centers available in the Additional Rates Cost Center level 1 drop down. This cell must be in a text format.

costCenter2.description: Not required. Valid values must match one of the system coded cost centers available in the Additional Rates Cost Center level 2 drop down. This cell must be in a text format.

costCenter3.description: Not required. Valid values must match one of the system coded cost centers available in the Additional Rates Cost Center level 3 drop down. This cell must be in a text format.

endCheckDate.description: Not required. Must match one of the system coded check dates available in the Additional Rates End Check Date drop down. Common formats include *MM-DD-CCYY*, *CCYY-MM-DD*.

job.description: Not required. If populated, must match one of the system coded values available in the Additional Rates Job drop down.

rate.description: Required. Enter dollar amount that corresponds to the Per selection.

rateCode.description: Required. If populated, must match one of the system coded values available in the Additional Rates Rate Code drop down.

ratePer.description: Required. Valid values are HOUR or WEEK.

shift.description: Not required. If populated, must match one of the system coded values available in the Additional Rates Shift drop down.

operations.name: Add update earning
operations.description: Add/Update Earning API sends new or updated employee earnings information directly to Web Pay.

agency.description: Third-party agency associated with earning. Must match Company setup.Max length: 10

amount.description: Value that matches CalculationCode to add to gross wages. For percentage (%), enter whole number (10 = 10%). Decimal(12,2)

annualMaximum.description: Year to Date dollar amount not to be exceeded for an earning in the calendar year. Used only with company driven maximums. Decimal(12,2)

calculationCode.description: Defines how earnings are calculated. Common values are *% (percentage of gross), flat (flat dollar amount)*. Defaulted to the Company setup calcCode for earning. Max length: 20

costCenter1.description: Cost Center associated with earning. Must match Company setup. Max length: 10

costCenter2.description: Cost Center associated with earning. Must match Company setup. Max length: 10

costCenter3.description: Cost Center associated with earning. Must match Company setup. Max length: 10

earningCode.description: Earning code. Must match Company setup. Max length: 10

effectiveDate.description: Date earning is active. Defaulted to run date or check date based on Company setup. Common formats are MM-DD-CCYY, CCYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Stop date of an earning. Common formats are MM-DD-CCYY, CCYY-MM-DD.

frequency.description: Needed if earning is applied differently from the payroll frequency (one time earning for example). Max length: 5

goal.description: Dollar amount. The employee earning will stop when the goal amount is reached. Decimal(12,2)

hoursOrUnits.description: The value is used in conjunction with the Rate field. When entering Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), it should contain the full amount of the group term life insurance policy. Decimal(12,2)

isSelfInsured.description: Used for ACA. If not entered, defaulted to Company earning setup.

jobCode.description: Job code associated with earnings. Must match Company setup. Max length: 20

miscellaneousInfo.description: Information to print on the check stub if agency is set up for this earning. Max length: 50

paidTowardsGoal.description: Amount already paid to employee toward goal. Decimal(12,2)

payPeriodMaximum.description: Maximum amount of the earning on a single paycheck. Decimal(12,2)

payPeriodMinimum.description: Minimum amount of the earning on a single paycheck. Decimal(12,2)

rate.description: Rate is used in conjunction with the hoursOrUnits field. Decimal(12,2)

rateCode.description: Rate Code applies to additional pay rates entered for an employee. Must match Company setup. Max length: 10

startDate.description: Start date of an earning based on payroll calendar. Common formats are MM-DD-CCYY, CCYY-MM-DD.

operations.name: Add update emergency contacts
operations.description: Sends new or updated employee emergency contacts directly to Web Pay.

county.description: Country. Must be a valid 3 character country code. Common values are *USA* (United States), *CAN* (Canada).

email.description: Contact email. Must be valid email address format.

firstName.description: Required. Contact first name. Max length: 40

homePhone.description: Contact Home Phone. Valid phone format *(###) #######* or *######-####* or *### ### ####* or *##########* or, if international, starts with *+#*, only spaces and digits allowed.

lastName.description: Required. Contact last name. Max length: 40

mobilePhone.description: Contact Mobile Phone. Valid phone format *(###) #######* or *######-####* or *### ### ####* or *##########* or, if international, starts with *+#*, only spaces and digits allowed.

pager.description: Contact Pager. Valid phone format *(###) #######* or *######-####* or *### ### ####* or *##########* or, if international, starts with *+#*, only spaces and digits allowed.

primaryPhone.description: Required. Contact primary phone type. Must match Company setup. Valid values are H (Home), M (Mobile), P (Pager), W (Work)

priority.description: Required. Contact priority. Valid values are *P* (Primary) or *S* (Secondary).

relationship.description: Required. Contact relationship. Must match Company setup. Common values are Spouse, Mother, Father.

state.description: State or Province. If U.S. address, must be valid 2 character state code. Common values are *IL* (Illinois), *CA* (California).

workPhone.description: Contact Work Phone. Valid phone format *(###) #######* or *######-####* or *### ### ####* or *##########* or, if international, starts with *+#*, only spaces and digits allowed.

zip.description: Postal code. If U.S. address, must be a valid zip code.

higherRate.description: Box 2(c) on form W4 (year 2020 or later): Multiple Jobs or Spouse Works. Boolean
